about: The reply block as the poll reads it: Get-ChatqReplyConfig (src/phone.ps1) of data/config.json at the clock - on, wanted, paired, topic and key as opened, master in hex, server, pairId, pairUntil, hours - and Get-ChatqPairKey (src/phone.ps1) of its answer as pairKey. A secret is {value, protected: false}, a protected text that is no DPAPI blob (it never opens), or {seal: <text>}, which each side seals by DPAPI for this user before it writes config.json: the vector holds no blob. A file is read as the tool reads it, so a zoneless stamp is UTC to 5.1 and the zone's wall clock to pwsh 7.
